Kim (Marketing): Quick final check before announce tomorrow 9am PT. Need public changelog URL, prod docs link, 1-sentence benchmark line, canary % and demo CTA routing. Can we lock by EOD?
Raj (Eng): Freeze confirmed. PR #3044 has changelog text; will go public on merge. Canary = 5% initial, rollback if error_rate > 0.5%.
Lea (Docs): Staging docs up: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/v2/serve. Will flip to prod after PR merge and add FAQ note about quantized models.
Connor (Sales): Demo CTA = "Request a dedicated demo" -> https://redwood.ai/demo. Add hidden field lead_tier=enterprise -> will route to sales webhook. Webhook tested.
Kim (Marketing): Benchmark line for blog: "In short-chat workloads, v2 delivers up to 2x faster p50; long sequences show smaller gains." Short and simple.
Raj (Eng): Canary config (snippet): `{"rollout": {"canary_fraction": 0.05, "fallback": "v1"}}`. Deploy scheduled in 30m.
DeployBot: Canary rollout scheduled 2026-09-10T16:00:00Z by @Raj
Lea (Docs): Changelog anchor added to docs; will update public link once PR merges.
Raj (Eng): PR merged, changelog public: https://redwood.ai/changelog/v2. Canary started, monitoring green.
Kim (Marketing): Final checklist: changelog public? docs prod? canary set? webhook + CTA live? webinar signup? press embargo?
Lea (Docs): Docs prod: yes. Changelog: yes.
Connor (Sales): CTA + webhook: yes. Webinar signup ready (Thu 11am PT).
Raj (Eng): Canary 5% live, rollback thresholds set.
Kim (Marketing): Great — scheduling announce for tomorrow 9am PT and sending embargo notes to press. Thanks all :rocket:
